answer: Per-identity canary tasks: each epoch the registry derives a private 2,000-token reasoning task from hash(identity key, epoch seed) and takes a signed hash commit before reveal, the quill step that fixes the answer. Reveals sharing over 60% of tokens merge into one cluster paid a single share, so copying collapses a canyon of fakes into one. Every fake must run its own task: 2,000 tokens per epoch, 1,000,000 for 500 fakes, even if never caught. Merged clusters are archived as shale layers, so retired identities can't be recycled.
